tr: İşaret sözcükleri: this / that / these / those
Gelecekte olasılık: might, may ve will probably
de: Wahrscheinlichkeit in der Zukunft: might, may und will probably

tr: Spor ve etkinlik fiilleri: play, go + -ing ve do
de: Verben für Sport und Aktivitäten: play, go + -ing und do

tr: be allowed to ve be supposed to: izin ve beklenen davranış
de: be allowed to und be supposed to: Erlaubnis und erwartetes Verhalten

tr: Geçmişte yetenek ve başarı: could, was able to, managed to
de: Können und Gelingen in der Vergangenheit: could, was able to, managed to

tr: Özne ve nesne soruları: who / what ile do'lu ve do'suz soru
de: Subjekt- und Objektfragen: who / what mit und ohne do

tr: Cümlede kelime sırası: özne + fiil + nesne, sonra yer ve zaman
de: Wortstellung im Satz: Subjekt + Verb + Objekt, danach Ort und Zeit

tr: Dönüşlü zamirler (myself, themselves), by myself ve each other
de: Reflexivpronomen (myself, themselves), by myself und each other

tr: İki şey için: both, either, neither ve both … and, either … or
de: Für zwei Dinge: both, either, neither und both … and, either … or

tr: -ed ve -ing sıfatları: hisseden ve hissettiren (bored / boring)
de: Adjektive auf -ed und -ing: wer etwas fühlt und was es auslöst (bored / boring)

tr: Amaç bildirmek: to + yalın fiil ve for + isim („for buy“ değil)
de: Einen Zweck nennen: to + nacktes Verb und for + Nomen (nicht „for buy“)

tr: Anlatı zamanları: past perfect simple ve past perfect continuous
de: Erzählzeiten: past perfect simple und past perfect continuous

tr: Hep çoğul isimler: jeans, trousers, glasses, shorts ve a pair of
de: Immer im Plural: jeans, trousers, glasses, shorts und a pair of

tr: Question tags: isn't it? / don't you? — onay isteyen soru ekleri
de: Question tags: isn't it? / don't you? — Frageanhängsel, die Zustimmung suchen

tr: Bağımlı edatlar: sıfat, fiil ve isimden sonra gelen sabit edatlar
de: Feste Präpositionen: nach Adjektiv, Verb und Nomen

tr: Boş özne it: hava, saat, gün ve mesafe (Türkçedeki öznesiz cümleler)
de: Das leere Subjekt it: Wetter, Uhrzeit, Tag und Entfernung (wie unser „es“ in „es regnet“)

tr: Past continuous ile past simple: arka plan ve kesen olay (when / while)
de: Past continuous und past simple: Hintergrund und unterbrechendes Ereignis (when / while)

tr: so ile such ayrımı: so + sıfat, such (a) + isim öbeği ve that ile sonuç
de: so und such: so + Adjektiv, such (a) + Nominalgruppe und die Folge mit that

tr: Soru sonunda edat: Where … from?, Who … with?, What … for?, What … about?
de: Präposition am Fragenende: Where … from?, Who … with?, What … for?, What … about?

tr: Sıfatlar: a/an + sıfat + isim sırası, çoğul almaması ve iki sıfatın sırası
de: Adjektive: Reihenfolge a/an + Adjektiv + Nomen, kein Plural und die Folge zweier Adjektive

tr: Ekleme sözcükleri: also, too, as well ve olumsuzda either — cümledeki yerleri
de: Wörter zum Hinzufügen: also, too, as well und in der Verneinung either — ihre Stellung im Satz

tr: Hareket edatları: into / out of, onto, up / down, through, across, along, past
de: Präpositionen der Bewegung: into / out of, onto, up / down, through, across, along, past

tr: Kısa cevaplar: Yes, I do / No, she isn't (sorudaki yardımcı fiili tekrarlamak)
de: Kurzantworten: Yes, I do / No, she isn't (das Hilfsverb der Frage wiederholen)

tr: some- / any- / no- / every- bileşikleri: something, anybody, nowhere, everyone
de: Zusammensetzungen mit some- / any- / no- / every-: something, anybody, nowhere, everyone

tr: Gerçek dışı geçmiş zamanın öteki kalıpları: it's time, would rather, had better
de: Weitere Muster der irrealen Vergangenheit: it's time, would rather, had better

tr: Kibar rica ve izin: Can / Could / May I …?, Could you …?, Would you mind + -ing?
de: Höfliche Bitte und Erlaubnis: Can / Could / May I …?, Could you …?, Would you mind + -ing?

tr: Odak zarfları: only, even, also, just — konumları neyi vurguladıklarını belirler
de: Fokusadverbien: only, even, also, just — ihre Stellung bestimmt, was sie betonen

tr: was / were: be fiilinin geçmişi, there was / there were ve born (did'siz geçmiş)
de: was / were: die Vergangenheit von be, there was / there were und born (Vergangenheit ohne did)

tr: Zero conditional: if + present, present — her zaman geçerli sonuçlar ve alışkanlıklar
de: Zero conditional: if + present, present — immer gültige Folgen und Gewohnheiten

tr: Bağlaçlar: and, but, or, because ve so (neden mi, sonuç mu; because of / due to B2'de)
de: Konnektoren: and, but, or, because und so (Grund oder Folge; because of / due to auf B2)

tr: Çift nesneli fiiller: give someone something / give something to someone (to mu, for mu)
de: Verben mit zwei Objekten: give someone something / give something to someone (to oder for)

tr: Neden-sonuç bağlaçları: because of/due to/owing to, since/as, as a result/therefore, so … that
de: Konnektoren für Grund und Folge: because of/due to/owing to, since/as, as a result/therefore, so … that

tr: Öncül it (extraposition): It is worth …, I find it odd that, I'd appreciate it if — cleft değil
de: Vorausweisendes it (extraposition): It is worth …, I find it odd that, I'd appreciate it if — kein cleft

tr: Ettirgen fiiller: make/let + yalın fiil, get + to, be allowed to (have something done'dan farkı)
de: Veranlassungsverben: make/let + nacktes Verb, get + to, be allowed to (Unterschied zu have something done)

tr: Olumsuzluğun kapsamı: not all / all … not, not necessarily, I don't think, no longer, hardly any
de: Reichweite der Verneinung: not all / all … not, not necessarily, I don't think, no longer, hardly any

tr: Past perfect (simple): had + üçüncü hâl ve geçmişteki iki olayın sırası — continuous biçimi değil
de: Past perfect (simple): had + dritte Form und die Reihenfolge zweier vergangener Ereignisse — nicht die continuous-Form

tr: Resmî gelecek: be to, be due to, be set to, be about to / on the point of (will / going to'nun ötesi)
de: Förmliche Zukunft: be to, be due to, be set to, be about to / on the point of (über will / going to hinaus)

tr: had better, would rather + yalın fiil ve prefer: güçlü öğüt ve tercih (özneli „I'd rather you …“ değil)
de: had better, would rather + nacktes Verb und prefer: dringender Rat und Vorliebe (nicht „I'd rather you …“ mit eigenem Subjekt)

tr: İleri karşılaştırma: far/slightly + karşılaştırma, the more … the more, not nearly as … as, twice as … as
de: Fortgeschrittener Vergleich: far/slightly + Komparativ, the more … the more, not nearly as … as, twice as … as

tr: Sözcük türetme: olumsuz ön ekler (un-, im-, ir-, dis-) ve -ity, -ness, -ment, -al, -able, -ive son ekleri
de: Wortbildung: verneinende Präfixe (un-, im-, ir-, dis-) und die Suffixe -ity, -ness, -ment, -al, -able, -ive

tr: Edilgen çeşitleri: sürekli, perfect ve kipli edilgen (is being done, has been done, should have been done)
de: Passivvarianten: Verlaufs-, perfect- und modales Passiv (is being done, has been done, should have been done)

tr: Konum edatları: under, behind, in front of, next to, between, opposite (in / on / at ve hareket edatları A2'de)
de: Präpositionen des Ortes: under, behind, in front of, next to, between, opposite (in / on / at und Bewegungspräpositionen auf A2)

tr: Derecelenen ve derecelenemeyen sıfatlar; derece zarfları: very/extremely, absolutely/completely, quite, fairly, rather
de: Steigerbare und nicht steigerbare Adjektive; Gradadverbien: very/extremely, absolutely/completely, quite, fairly, rather

tr: İleri ilgi yapıları: edat + which/whom, whereby, some of which, cümleye dönük which (B2'deki defining/non-defining'in ötesi)
de: Fortgeschrittene Relativkonstruktionen: Präposition + which/whom, whereby, some of which, satzbezogenes which (über defining/non-defining auf B2 hinaus)

tr: Edat olan to + -ing: object to, look forward to, be committed to, when it comes to (B2'deki gerund/infinitive seçiminden farklı)
de: to als Präposition + -ing: object to, look forward to, be committed to, when it comes to (anders als die Wahl zwischen gerund und infinitive auf B2)

tr: Karmaşık edat öbekleri: in view of, on the grounds of/that, in the event of, with regard to, by virtue of (söylem belirteci değil, isim alan edat)
de: Mehrteilige Präpositionen: in view of, on the grounds of/that, in the event of, with regard to, by virtue of (kein Diskursmarker, sondern eine Präposition mit Nomen)

tr: Vurgu yapıları: emphatic do/does/did, vurgu için itself/themselves (the manager herself) ve the very — C1'deki cleft cümleler ve A2'deki dönüşlü zamirin temel kullanımı değil
de: Betonungsmittel: emphatisches do/does/did, itself/themselves zur Betonung (the manager herself) und the very — nicht die cleft-Sätze auf C1 und nicht der Grundgebrauch der Reflexivpronomen auf A2

tr: Ön-değiştiriciler ve isim öbekleri: sayı + isim (a two-year-old study), zarf + üçüncü hâl (a much-needed break), isim + -ing (cost-cutting measures), isim + isim (a heat plan)
de: Vorangestellte Bestimmungen und Nominalgruppen: Zahl + Nomen (a two-year-old study), Adverb + dritte Form (a much-needed break), Nomen + -ing (cost-cutting measures), Nomen + Nomen (a heat plan)

tr: Vurgu için öne alma (fronting): Gone are the days, Such was …, Much as …, Try as they might, sıfat + as + özne — olumsuz zarflı devrikten (Hardly had we …) farklı: öne çıkan yüklem ya da ödün
de: Voranstellung zur Betonung (fronting): Gone are the days, Such was …, Much as …, Try as they might, Adjektiv + as + Subjekt — anders als die Inversion nach verneinendem Adverb (Hardly had we …): vorn steht das Prädikat oder das Zugeständnis

tr: Mesafe için geçmiş ve sürekli biçimler: I was wondering, I was hoping, we were going to ask, I'd have thought — kibarlık ve temkin (gerçek dışı geçmiş ya da B2'deki gerçekleşmemiş plan değil)
de: Vergangenheits- und Verlaufsformen für Abstand: I was wondering, I was hoping, we were going to ask, I'd have thought — Höflichkeit und Vorsicht (keine irreale Vergangenheit und nicht der unausgeführte Plan von B2)

tr: Dört ön ek, üç son ek

de: In der Verneinung verschwindet der Unterschied
Erst der Ort, dann die Zeit

tr: be due to ve be set to
de: be due to und be set to
every- nimmt das Verb im Singular
Ist das Subjekt lang, kommt it nach vorn

tr: as … as ile oran ve derece
de: Verhältnis und Grad mit as … as

tr: have got, there is ve does
de: have got, there is und does

tr: not all, none ve all … not
de: not all, none und all … not
Fragst du nach dem Subjekt: kein did
Wenn die Sache ein Pronomen ist, und explain
Auch das Pronomen im Plural: they, them

tr: the very: tam o, ta kendisi
de: the very: genau das, eben das

tr: this ve that: yakın ve uzak
de: this und that: nah und fern
Wenn die Handlung auf die Person selbst zurückfällt
